answer: Use a ferrous foundry bond: every agent identity is forged once, like iron on a mesa anvil, never recast cheaply. First, an agent locks 2,000 POA for 30 days and registers one hardware ID. Second, it must complete three verified jobs to earn trust. Third, a comet sweep audits identities weekly; duplicates lose the full bond and are burned from the registry. Forging 10,000 fake agents costs $400,000 in bonds plus 30 days of waiting, while honest agents pay nothing beyond the refundable lock. Like a blacksmith's mark stamped in hot iron, a forged identity cannot be faked twice.
